newsitem.title: UK: EU seen awarding at least 60,000 T sugar at tender.
newsitem.headline: EU seen awarding at least 60,000 T sugar at tender.

text.p: The European Union (EU) is expected to award at least 60,000 tonnes of current series white sugar at its weekly tender on Wednesday, the seventh of the new series for 1996/97.
Several traders forecast tonnages of between 60,000 and 80,000 tonnes, while a more liberal estimate was around 100,000 tonnes.
"There is talk of a large tonnage," one trader said.
The maximum restitution for licences this week was seen just above 43 Ecus (European currency units) per 100 kilos of sugar.
Last week a total of 93,500 tonnes of current series white sugar received export rebates of a maximum 43.392 Ecus per 100 kilos. --London Newsroom +44 171 510 8075
